issues.title: Epic: Governance, discovery, and product decisions
issues.body:
## User or Engineering Value
Establishes repository rules, delivery workflow, and project planning tools so agents and engineers can operate effectively without conflict.

## Scope
- Repository settings and structure
- GitHub Project creation and configuration
- Issue and PR templates
- Milestone and label creation
- Core documentation (`AGENTS.md`, workflows)

## Out of Scope
- Feature implementation

## Acceptance Criteria
- `AGENTS.md` and workflow docs exist.
- GitHub Project exists and is private.
- Issues are populated.
- Labels and milestones are created.

## Dependencies
- None

## Demo Relevance
- Required for organized delivery.

issues.title: Epic: Monorepo and local infrastructure
issues.body:
## User or Engineering Value
Provides the foundation for building the web apps and APIs locally with consistent tooling.

## Scope
- pnpm workspace setup
- Next.js and NestJS initialization
- Docker Compose (PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Redis)
- ESLint, Prettier, and TypeScript configs

## Acceptance Criteria
- `pnpm dev` starts the monorepo.
- `docker-compose up` runs the databases.
- DBs are accessible.

## Dependencies
- M0 Epic

## Demo Relevance
- Core infrastructure.

issues.title: Epic: CI, quality gates, logging, and OpenAPI
issues.body:
## User or Engineering Value
Ensures code quality and provides API contracts for the frontend.

## Scope
- GitHub Actions (Lint, Test, Build)
- Pino logging setup
- Swagger/OpenAPI setup in NestJS

## Acceptance Criteria
- PRs require passing CI.
- `api/docs` serves Swagger UI.

## Dependencies
- Monorepo Epic

issues.title: Monorepo workspace setup

## Acceptance Criteria

## Demo Relevance
